title: Rosetta Code Challenges
subtitle: Classic programming tasks, each solvable in every language the platform runs. Short, self-contained, and graded the same way whichever one you pick.
attribution: Task names are the long-standing titles used across the Rosetta Code community and elsewhere; a task name is an idea, not protected text. Every description, every hint and every test in this course is written for this platform.
